The 2026 Nobel Peace Prize went to South African jurist Navi Pillay, announced October 9, 2026 in Oslo. Multiple sources agree on this: Khaleej Times reports that the committee named Navanethem "Navi" Pillay, and the Wikipedia entry lists her as the laureate. The committee cited her efforts to promote peace and international law, and described her "firm moral compass" as a constant in her career.

The announcement was made by Jørgen Watne Frydnes, chair of the Norwegian Nobel Committee. The award ceremony is set for 10 December 2026 in Oslo. The prize is 12 million Swedish kronor.

The 2026 field was large. 287 candidates were nominated, including 208 individuals and 79 organisations. The committee does not publicly confirm nominees.
